key_reasoning.reason: diffstat reports 541 files changed, which maps mechanically to XXL. The count is dominated by churn, not authorship: exactly one file (.gitignore, 29 insertions) was edited, and the other 540 paths are `git rm --cached` untrackings under docs/superpowers/tasks/ (418) and docs/superpowers/runs/ (122) with no content authored. The XXL descriptor is still defensible on its second clause — the sweep changes what the repository tracks — but this dimension alone accounts for 6 of the 14 points and is the sole reason the total clears the S floor.

Base risk is S: the same .gitignore already carries a keep-list block (`.codemie/*` plus `!` re-inclusion rows), so the pattern was copied rather than invented, and `git rm --cached` is fully reversible with files left on disk and no history rewrite. Bumped to M because gitignore negation semantics are subtle (directory re-inclusion needs its own `!docs/superpowers/*/` and `*/**/` depth rows or the keep-list silently fails) and no repository gate covers docs/ — verification was manual git-evidence commands, with no test template asserting that a keep-listed artifact stays tracked while a disposable sibling stays ignored.
